choice: Winsorise each analysis split and keep all 11 measurements. Drop the red/white type tag. Leave case weights in their recipe role.
why: The formula puts s(x, k = 5) on every measurement. step_corr can drop a column inside a fold, and then that term has no edf. The other models still use the correlation filter. A recipe that omits the case-weight column strips that role, so the weights arm uses quality ~ . and removes only type.

choice: Ridge, mixture fixed at 0, penalty tuned
why: The spec tunes the penalty only. Lasso can zero one of the three named bases, so the stack would no longer combine them.
The proposal asks for the blender's own repeated 10-fold CV. Ten repeats is the repeated CV already used for selection.

choice: Cut-off from the selected penalty's out-of-fold probabilities, averaged to one row, before the test matrix is read
why: The acceptance test requires the penalty and the cut-off to be identical for two different test matrices. The test set is predicted once after that.

choice: First the Mersenne-Twister seed-1 stream, then the original L'Ecuyer job index, same as the PR AUC refit
why: Those are the two attempts that reproduced the stored test metrics. The 10 by 10 that saves out-of-fold probabilities runs after a passing test fit and does not move that stream.

choice: Binomial glm of high/low on the repeat-averaged out-of-fold score only. The blender keeps the raw score; only the simple average uses the mapped probability.
why: The proposal maps the score for the average. The blender is a logistic regression on the three out-of-fold predictions, and glmnet standardises its columns. Fitting the map on every training row would let it see labels that a blender fold holds out.

choice: Stored radial-SVM test balanced accuracy, seeds 2021 to 2025
why: The comparison is against the saved radial SVM, not a new draw. A positive difference is strictly greater than zero, and the mean must exceed the sample sd.

choice: Keep passing non-integer class weights to mgcv and muffle only the binomial non-integer warning
why: The weights are inverse class frequencies, not counts. mgcv still maximises the weighted likelihood and prints that warning on every fit.

choice: Ask fit_resamples for balanced accuracy and ROC AUC
why: Balanced accuracy only makes tune save the class. ROC AUC makes it save P(high), which is what the cut-off and the stack read. The extra metric does not change the fit.

choice: Keep the 25-point dials penalty grid after every seed selected 1e-10
why: That grid was fixed before the run. Extending it below 1e-10 after seeing the scores would be a second search. The drop rule is applied to this fit.
